name: Siren
description: Sirens are mythological singers of Greek tradition, originally depicted as bird-women whose irresistible song lures sailors to their deaths on rocky islands of the western Mediterranean. From the early medieval period the figure was progressively conflated with the fish-tailed mermaid; modern usage encompasses both forms.

aliases.name: Parthenope
aliases.meaning: named siren whose tomb was the legendary foundation of Naples

origin: Greek and Roman literary geography places the sirens in the western Mediterranean, principally off the Tyrrhenian and Campanian coasts of Italy. The medieval mermaid-siren is much more widely distributed across European bestiary geography.
